_comment: Play's Data Safety form as data — the twin of docs/STORE-FORMS.md §3, held equal to it by scripts/check-store-forms.mjs rule 6. PARKED under D42: Play is deferred, nothing here has been filed. It exists because §3's answers were derived once from an audited inventory and a transposed row survived in that table for weeks with nothing able to read it. docs/data-inventory.md stays canonical; if this file and that one disagree, that one is right.
$canonical: docs/data-inventory.md is the audited source. docs/STORE-FORMS.md §3 is the prose this file is compared against. Neither this file nor that section decides anything on its own.
$openBeforeFiling: Three answers below are NOT settled and §3 says so at length: the Shared column after D98 (an owner/legal call, not an edit), the App activity row against D270/D272, and the Purchases row against D313/D315. They are carried here as currently derived so the gate has something to hold — carrying them is not endorsing them.

rows.category: Personal info → Political or religious beliefs
App activity, Web browsing, Contacts, Photos, Financial, Purchases

$encryptedInTransit: All traffic is HTTPS to Firebase.
$deletionRequestUrl: Play requires BOTH an in-app deletion path and a web URL that can be reached without installing the app, and enforces the URL independently of the rest of this form. The in-app half is the privacy panel's delete button (the deleteAccount callable). web/delete-account.html is the web half: publicly reachable, no login, states what is deleted, what is kept and why, and how long it takes. It is linked from web/privacy.html so it is discoverable as well as addressable.
$advertisingIdCollected: No advertising ID is collected and no ad SDK ships. This is a DIFFERENT question from the store listing's Contains ads declaration, which is Yes since D315 — one asks about an identifier, the other about the presence of ads. Keeping them apart is the point.
